sources.title: Slow-Roll Inflation in Non-geometric Flux Compactification

evidence.text: Which constrained integer-flux configurations yield stable non-supersymmetric dS or AdS extrema in an isotropic type IIB non-geometric model, and do the reported dS examples admit small-field, multi-field slow-roll conditions?

sources.title: More stable de Sitter vacua from S-dual nongeometric fluxes

evidence.text: Can S-dual nongeometric P-fluxes and torus anisotropy produce further stable dS/AdS candidates, remove instabilities hidden by isotropic truncations, and change the moduli hierarchies relevant to small-field inflation?

sources.title: Heterotic Moduli Stabilisation and Non-Supersymmetric Vacua

evidence.text: Can heterotic geometric moduli and the dilaton be stabilized perturbatively in finite-coupling, nonsupersymmetric vacua, and can the resulting AdS minima be lifted to dS?

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Could a flat family through a supersymmetric AdS vacuum provide stable nonsupersymmetric AdS examples? The source considers this mechanism in relation to the cited instability conjecture.

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Can D8 interface conditions admit supersymmetry-breaking families, and what nonsupersymmetric solutions exist away from supersymmetric branches? Both questions remain open in this work.

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Does large volume and weak coupling guarantee that smeared branes approximate localized AdS7 vacua when the same limit changes brane number?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Could eliminating all boundary five-brane poles produce a stable non-supersymmetric AdS6 sibling?

sources.title: Supergravity solutions for Dp-D(6 − p) bound states: from p = 7 to p = −1

evidence.text: Can Dp–D(6−p) electric/magnetic bound states stabilize the dilaton and support AdS near horizons? The construction focuses on the less understood D0–D6, D2–D4 and D(−1)–D7 systems.

sources.title: An attempt to derive the LVS from a 10d EFT perspective

evidence.text: Can the pre-uplift LVS AdS potential, including its leading volume suppressions, be recovered directly from ten-dimensional EFT without assuming four-dimensional supergravity? The paper investigates a conditional mismatch rather than establishing failure of LVS.

sources.title: (A)dS backgrounds from asymmetric orientifolds

evidence.text: Can asymmetric orientifold projections and discrete RR fluxes remove NSNS runaway directions and stabilize the dilaton at weak coupling, producing critical-string AdS6 backgrounds and a supercritical-string metastable dS4 candidate?

sources.title: Slow-Roll Inflation in Non-geometric Flux Compactification

evidence.text: Integer flux configurations satisfying R-R tadpole, T-dual tadpole and Q·H3=Q·Q=0 Bianchi constraints are generated before numerical minimisation. A genetic algorithm searches the six real moduli with stated convergence criterion 10^-20 and a finite flux cutoff.

sources.title: More stable de Sitter vacua from S-dual nongeometric fluxes

evidence.text: The displayed superpotential is W=P₀−SP₁+Σm(P₂m−SP₃m)Um, with cubic polynomials in the complex-structure fields and coefficients determined by fluxes. The Kähler potential is K=−Σi=1⁷ln(2ψi). Numerical mass matrices, F-terms and gravitino quantities characterize the candidates.

sources.title: Heterotic Moduli Stabilisation and Non-Supersymmetric Vacua

evidence.text: Uses algebraic stationary-point analysis with STRINGVACUA for a simple example and numerical continuation from aligned D-terms to deformed configurations. Uplift searches examine the effective dilaton potential, loop corrections and nonperturbative superpotential terms.

sources.title: On SUSY-breaking moduli spaces of AdS$_{7}$ vacua and 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Construct power or logarithmic Frobenius bases, reject inadmissible branches and match values and derivatives across patches. The paper reports finite-order matching results; it does not supply certified global truncation-error bounds.

sources.title: O‐Plane Backreaction and Scale Separation in Type IIA Flux Vacua

evidence.text: Reduce the action and perform the Weyl transformation. The source's intervening conversion of localized energy to bulk energy must remain conditional: its printed multi-source normalization fails a simple limit, and nonclosed forms introduce additional derivative terms.

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Reduce the curve equations using the ϕ isometry and a constant-radius ansatz, then test internal and radial stationarity against the full action. The source's proposed reduction is not verified by its printed coefficients.

sources.title: Deforming AdS3×S3×T4AdS3×S3×T4 in Type IIB Supergravity

evidence.text: Can Type IIB backgrounds WAdS3 × WS3 × T4 preserve supersymmetry with independent warpings of the two curved factors, and which such backgrounds arise as near-horizon limits of regular brane-and-flux configurations that are asymptotically locally flat?

sources.title: Purely nonperturbative AdS vacua and the swampland

evidence.text: Do purely nonperturbative AdS vacua with W0 = 0 meet the axionic WGC and AdS-moduli conjecture, and can their spectator Kähler moduli be stabilized?

sources.title: On AdS$_{7}$ stability

evidence.text: Are the known non-supersymmetric sisters of supersymmetric type-IIA AdS7 vacua perturbatively or nonperturbatively unstable, and can these families exhibit separation between AdS and Kaluza–Klein scales?

sources.title: AdS$_{D}$× I solutions in axio-dilaton gravity

evidence.text: Which non-supersymmetric warped AdS_D × I backgrounds occur in exponential axio-dilaton gravity, what controls their spatial asymptotics, and when can their singularities acquire a higher-dimensional or brane interpretation?

sources.title: Metastable vacua from torsion and machine learning

evidence.text: Can torsional five-form contributions and wrapped non-BPS branes provide minimal ingredients for classically stable non-SUSY AdS vacua and their uplift to dS, and what possible instabilities remain?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric heterotic strings on a circle

evidence.text: What are the classical moduli space, gauge enhancements and one-loop potential extrema of non-supersymmetric heterotic strings on a circle, and what do their instabilities imply for flux-supported AdS3 constructions?

sources.title: On the DGKT brane dual and its decoupling

evidence.text: Can one construct a ten-dimensional brane geometry whose near-horizon limit reproduces scale-separated DGKT vacua, and does its brane sector decouple from the bulk despite the unusual asymptotic blueshift?

sources.title: Supersymmetric scale-separated AdS$_{3}$ orientifold vacua of type IIB

evidence.text: Can classical type IIB compactifications yield minimally supersymmetric AdS3 vacua with stabilized geometric scalars, weak coupling, large internal radii and parametric separation between the AdS and KK scales?

sources.title: Metastable vacua from torsion and machine learning

evidence.text: Can the proposed classical AdS and uplifted dS candidates remain compatible with conjectured quantum-gravity restrictions on non-supersymmetric vacua, scale separation and positive scalar-potential minima?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS from string theory

evidence.text: Can the non-supersymmetric heterotic string support parametrically controlled AdS3 backgrounds without perturbative scalar instabilities, including vacua supported essentially by string loops? Can its positive one-loop vacuum energy instead produce de Sitter space?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Can an AdS tower argument survive an uplift to positive vacuum energy? The proposed transfer assumes that a positive inverse-volume contribution shifts the stabilized moduli only slightly.

sources.title: Testing Swampland Conjectures with Machine Learning

evidence.text: How do potential values and other features vary across the critical points found by ANN+GA? The analyzed sample includes AdS and dS points without imposing stability, and distinguishes two flux cases.

sources.title: Revisiting constraints on uplifts to de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can brane-based uplifts of type IIB AdS vacua satisfy both the integrated Gibbons–Maldacena–Nuñez constraint and the constraint reproducing four-dimensional Einstein equations, rather than only giving a positive four-dimensional effective potential?

sources.title: Crisis on Infinite Earths: Short-lived de Sitter Vacua in the String Theory Landscape

evidence.text: Can additional AdS decay destinations make uplifted string-theoretic dS vacua short-lived enough to satisfy the assumed TCC bound, and are the underlying static four-dimensional assumptions compatible with higher-dimensional equations?

sources.title: AdS in warped space-times

evidence.text: How can semi-localised brane intersections generate AdS factors whose warp factors depend only on internal coordinates, providing candidate AdS/CFT backgrounds and lower-dimensional gauged-supergravity embeddings?

sources.title: 7D (non-)susy vacua & DWs from dynamical open strings

evidence.text: Can dynamical open-string scalars and non-Abelian fluxes generate additional supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric AdS7 vacua, and what do interpolating domain walls imply about stability within the retained fields?

sources.title: Open strings in type IIB AdS$_{3}$ flux vacua

evidence.text: Do dynamical D5-brane open strings destabilise previously found nonsupersymmetric type IIB AdS3 vacua, generate additional stable vacua, or alter their proposed scale separation?

sources.title: New instabilities for non-supersymmetric AdS$_{4}$ orientifold vacua

evidence.text: Can the perturbatively stable non-supersymmetric DGKT-like branches be described with localised sources in ten dimensions, and do wrapped-brane membranes supply non-perturbative instabilities consistent with the membrane WGC and its sharpening?

sources.title: Engineering a bosonic AdS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Can an added form flux support a tachyon-stable, non-supersymmetric bosonic AdS background and a conjectural boundary CFT, with finite-temperature scalar spectra interpreted as glueballs?

sources.title: Quantum Horizons of the Standard Model Landscape

evidence.text: Does the Standard Model coupled to gravity possess lower-dimensional vacua stabilized by vacuum and Casimir energies, and can quantum black objects interpolate between these vacua and higher-dimensional spacetime?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Can positive energy uplift a quantum-stabilized AdS vacuum while preserving stabilization? The relevant starting data include supersymmetry, nonzero superpotential, and whether stabilization uses KKLT, LVS, or more elaborate nonperturbative effects.

sources.title: On the branes behind scale-separated AdS$_{3}$ flux vacua

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric type IIB AdS3 flux vacua with parametrically separated characteristic lengths be realised as near-horizon limits of brane intersections, and which branes carry the unrestricted fluxes controlling the hierarchy?

sources.title: A landscape of non-supersymmetric AdS vacua on coset manifolds

evidence.text: Can sourceless nonsupersymmetric type IIA AdS4 vacua be constructed by retaining the geometry of supersymmetric SU(3)-structure solutions while changing their fluxes, and which examples survive tests of left-invariant scalar fluctuations?

sources.title: Aspects of type IIA AdS4 orientifold vacua

evidence.text: Which supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric type IIA AdS4 orientifold flux vacua arise, and how do stability, scale separation, localized ten-dimensional uplift and membrane decay constrain them?

sources.title: BIonic membranes and AdS instabilities

evidence.text: Can wrapped D-brane membranes produce non-perturbative decays of perturbatively stable, non-supersymmetric AdS4 flux vacua once curvature effects and localization of D6/O6 sources are included?

sources.title: Wrapped Brane Solutions in Romans $F(4)$ Gauged Supergravity

evidence.text: Which lower-dimensional supersymmetric and non-supersymmetric AdS fixed points arise from wrapped D4-branes in Romans F(4) supergravity, which UV-to-IR flows reach them, and what stability or singularity tests do they satisfy?
